svg.title: The super-seo gadget belt
svg.desc: A comic utility belt where eleven free extension gadgets click into place one by one around a central buckle: Google, Bing, IndexNow, PostHog, Matomo, Umami, Cloudflare, Lighthouse, Browser, Shopify and YouTube, plus an empty slot for the next one.
svg.text: Free extensions. Each one clicks in the moment its key or tool is found.
